decisions.reason: The request concerns the integrated-board quotation package, not the independently maintained power-board production files.
The integrated-board request does not change the sensor-board BOM, Gerbers, drill files, or positions.csv requirements.
The source Event targets the integrated-board production package and does not establish a new requirement for the earlier main-board package.
Component positions are a production-package deliverable and do not alter the separate requirement to verify component orientations.
Requesting files for a supplier quotation does not change the manufacturing-account access, cart setup, or Basic-part review requirements.
The BOM and component-position request does not change connector labels, QR codes, or other board markings.
The production-document request leaves the existing lead-free assembly constraint unchanged.
Although a BOM may support sourcing review, the source does not change any component availability, fallback, or sourceability rule.
The request for production documentation does not modify the integrated display-backlight circuit specification.
The production-package request does not change the integrated board's power-management architecture or operating constraints.
The BOM and component-position deliverables do not modify the high-current routing or copper-continuity requirements.
Obtaining a supplier quote is consistent with cost review but does not change the existing cost-optimization requirements.
